endpoints.name: Agent list
endpoints.description: The agents on the account, with name, email, role and status.

endpoints.name: Agent
endpoints.description: One agent by user id.

endpoints.name: Agent statuses in departments
endpoints.description: One agent's availability per department. Requires a user id. Availability is per department rather than global, so an agent can be online for chat and offline for calls.

endpoints.name: Agent activity list
endpoints.description: Agent activity records, filtered -- when agents were online, on calls or handling chats. The staffing and utilisation table.

endpoints.name: Ban list
endpoints.description: The banned visitors and addresses, filtered. Moderation; also the explanation for contacts whose messages never became tickets.

endpoints.name: Ban
endpoints.description: One ban by id.

endpoints.name: Call list
endpoints.description: Phone calls, filtered. The voice channel, with direction, duration and the agent who took it.

endpoints.name: Call status
endpoints.description: The live status of one call, optionally including agents currently unreachable. Requires a call id. A real-time snapshot, not history.

endpoints.name: Canned message list
endpoints.description: The canned responses agents insert. Which exist and which are used says a good deal about the standard cases a team handles.

endpoints.name: Canned message
endpoints.description: One canned message by id.

endpoints.name: Chat list
endpoints.description: Live chat conversations, filtered. Chats become tickets, so these overlap with the ticket table -- this is the chat-specific view with its own timings such as wait time before an agent joined.

endpoints.name: Company list
endpoints.description: The companies contacts belong to, filtered. The account-level dimension ticket volume can be grouped by.

endpoints.name: Company
endpoints.description: One company by id.

endpoints.name: Contact list
endpoints.description: The customers who have contacted support, filtered. Carries name, emails, phone numbers and the company each belongs to.

endpoints.name: Contact
endpoints.description: One contact by id.

endpoints.name: Custom button list
endpoints.description: The custom buttons configured in the agent interface, filtered. Interface configuration.

endpoints.name: Custom button
endpoints.description: One custom button by id.

endpoints.name: Department list
endpoints.description: The departments tickets are routed to, filtered. The team dimension.

endpoints.name: Department
endpoints.description: One department by id.

endpoints.name: Is agent in department
endpoints.description: Whether one agent belongs to one department. Requires both ids. A membership check rather than a listing.

endpoints.name: Device list
endpoints.description: The devices registered on the account, filtered.

endpoints.name: Device
endpoints.description: One device by id.

endpoints.name: Device departments
endpoints.description: The departments one device serves. Requires a device id.

endpoints.name: Device department by id
endpoints.description: One device-to-department assignment.

endpoints.name: Device department plan
endpoints.description: The routing plan for one device in one department.

endpoints.name: Device departments by department id
endpoints.description: The devices serving one department. The reverse view.

endpoints.name: Filter list
endpoints.description: The saved ticket filters defined, filtered. These encode the queues agents actually work from, so their definitions state the team's own categories.

endpoints.name: Filter
endpoints.description: One saved filter by id, with its conditions.

endpoints.name: List of reports for time reports grid
endpoints.description: Time-based report rows, filtered. LiveAgent's own reporting output -- pre-aggregated, and the cheaper route to figures that would otherwise be computed from ticket history.

endpoints.name: Contact group list
endpoints.description: The groups contacts are organised into. The customer segmentation dimension.

endpoints.name: Contact group
endpoints.description: One contact group by id.

endpoints.name: Message
endpoints.description: One message by id, optionally with a substring of its body. The individual message rather than the ticket conversation.

endpoints.name: Page visits
endpoints.description: The pages one contact visited on the website before contacting support. Requires a contact id. Behavioural context for a ticket, which the ticket itself does not carry.

endpoints.name: Phone numbers list
endpoints.description: The phone numbers configured, with the department each routes to. The inbound voice routing map.

endpoints.name: Phone number
endpoints.description: One phone number by id.

endpoints.name: Available dial out prefix
endpoints.description: The dial-out prefixes available. Configuration for outbound calling.

endpoints.name: Phone device list
endpoints.description: The registered phone devices -- softphones and hardware -- agents take calls on.

endpoints.name: Phone device
endpoints.description: One phone device by id.

endpoints.name: Predefined answer list
endpoints.description: The predefined answers available, filtered. Similar to canned messages, used in different contexts.

endpoints.name: Predefined answer
endpoints.description: One predefined answer by id.

endpoints.name: Batch status and remaining items to process
endpoints.description: The progress of a queued batch operation. Requires a batch id. Operational.

endpoints.name: Settings list
endpoints.description: The account settings, optionally by name. Configuration, and worth checking when a feature-dependent table comes back empty.

endpoints.name: Sla list
endpoints.description: The SLA levels defined, with their response and resolution targets. The targets that make a duration fast or slow; a raw resolution time means nothing without them.

endpoints.name: Sla
endpoints.description: One SLA level by id.

endpoints.name: Ticket Sla history
endpoints.description: The SLA events of one ticket over time. Requires the ticket id. When the clock started, paused and stopped -- and therefore why a breach happened.

endpoints.name: Tag list
endpoints.description: The tags applied to tickets. The free-form categorisation, and usually the only statement of what tickets are about beyond their subject line.

endpoints.name: Tag
endpoints.description: One tag by id.

endpoints.name: Ticket list
endpoints.description: The support tickets, filtered by LiveAgent's own _filters expression. Carries the subject, the customer, the department and assigned agent, status, channel, tags, and the created and changed timestamps. The central table. NOTE THE CHANNEL COLUMN: LiveAgent unifies email, chat, phone calls and social messages into one ticket stream, so a ticket count spans channels that behave nothing alike -- a chat and an email ticket have very different natural durations, and mixing them makes an average response time meaningless.

endpoints.name: Ticket
endpoints.description: One ticket by id, with its full detail.

endpoints.name: Ticket attribute
endpoints.description: One named attribute of a ticket, such as whether a chat or call has ended. Requires the ticket id and attribute name.

endpoints.name: Ticket history
endpoints.description: The change history of one ticket: status changes, transfers, assignments, each with the actor and timestamp. Requires a ticket id. The ticket holds current state only, so response and resolution timings are derived from here.

endpoints.name: Ticket message groups and messages
endpoints.description: The conversation on one ticket, grouped into message groups. Requires a ticket id. Where the actual text lives -- the ticket record carries only its subject.

endpoints.name: Ticket Sla
endpoints.description: The SLA applying to one ticket and its current state against it. Requires a ticket id. Whether a ticket is breaching is only answerable here; the ticket itself carries no SLA field.

endpoints.name: Tickets history list
endpoints.description: Ticket history events across all tickets, filtered. The account-wide change log, and the practical basis for time-in-status analysis without a request per ticket.

endpoints.name: User
endpoints.description: One user by id.
